zh: 新增「組合現金流」計算器，可把儲蓄保險、定期／存款、基金／ETF／股票、買樓收租、債券／派息產品及自訂資產放進同一個產品清單，最多同時計算 8 個產品。每個產品會按類型顯示專屬參數，不需要再自行用文字描述收益規則。
新增生活消費模型：輸入目前每月開支、每年開支增長／通脹及計算年期後，系統逐年計算產品產生的現金收入、當年生活開支及「真正可支配現金流 = 產品現金收入 − 開支」。可選擇把每年現金結餘／缺口累積進總資產，直接觀察生活消費如何影響長期淨資產。
結果同時提供兩條獨立比例尺曲線：「淨資產變化」及「每年可支配現金流」，避免數百萬資產把幾萬元現金流壓成直線；另提供首次完全覆蓋開支年份、期末開支覆蓋率、累計可支配現金、期末各產品資產／現金貢獻及可摺疊逐年明細。
不同產品使用不同現金流規則：儲蓄保險提款會真實扣減保單餘額；定期可選利息滾存或直接取息；基金／ETF 的「總回報」會拆成淨值增長與現金派息，避免把 7% 總回報 + 2% 派息錯算成 9%；收租物業可獨立設定樓價及租金增長；債券／派息產品分開計算資產升值與現金派息。
「投資 · 理財」首頁新增組合現金流入口；智能計算器的被動收入／被動收入目標／本金派息結果亦新增「用多產品組合繼續計算」，並會把已知的月開支帶入新頁。
新增產品現金流數值回歸與 390×844 手機實操回歸，涵蓋提款扣減、派息防重複計算、通脹、定期取息／滾存、動態新增產品及類型切換。完整 Flutter 測試擴充至 133 項並全部通過，360×640 特大字及 390×844 特大字均無 overflow，Web Release 構建成功。
en: Added Portfolio Cash Flow, a multi-product calculator that combines savings insurance, deposits, funds/ETFs/stocks, rental property, bonds/income products and custom assets on one timeline, with up to eight products and type-specific structured inputs.

Added spending modelling. Enter current monthly spending, annual expense inflation/growth and the projection horizon to calculate product cash income, living expenses and true disposable cash flow (`product cash income - spending`) year by year. Disposable surplus/deficit can optionally accumulate into net assets.

Added separate net-asset and disposable-cash-flow charts so large asset values do not flatten smaller cash-flow movements. Results also show the first fully covered year, ending coverage ratio, cumulative disposable cash, final product breakdown and a collapsible year-by-year table.

Product-specific cash-flow rules prevent misleading totals: savings-insurance withdrawals reduce policy value; deposits can reinvest or pay out interest; market total return is split between NAV growth and cash yield to avoid double counting; rental property separates appreciation from rent; income products separate asset growth from distributions.
Added a Portfolio Cash Flow card under Investing and a continuation action from Smart Calculator passive-income results, carrying known monthly spending into the multi-product planner.

Added numerical and 390×844 mobile regressions for withdrawals, payout double-count protection, inflation, deposit payout/reinvestment, dynamic products and type switching. The full Flutter suite now has 133 passing tests, large-text 360×640 and 390×844 layouts have no overflow, and the Web release build succeeds.
